routes.fssr_positive_identity: Cube sugar consists of white cube/cuboid blocks manufactured from refined crystallised sugar, with sucrose at least 99.7% by weight, moisture at most 0.25%, and total ash at most 0.03%. Permitted additives may be present, requiring actual formula review.
routes.subroute: Only unblended plain cube/cuboid sugar manufactured solely by shaping refined crystallised sugar; if any additives, colour or other ingredients are used, obtain a separate positive finished article ruling.
required_positive_proofs: Confirm as-sold finished food standard FSSR 2.8.1(5) and manufacturing route from documented refined crystallised sugar input.
Obtain batch process/recipe showing pressed sugar cubes versus composite, coated, coloured or flavoured confection.
Obtain qualified legal documentation that the Chromium CTR named article 'Refined sugar' applies to the marketed sugar cubes rather than only the loose refined sugar raw material.
Verify the actual finished lot and analytical sample matrix for chromium; this source panel cannot generate an analytical pass.
For any lead refined-white-sugar article, obtain measured sulphated ash and exact source-qualified marketed refined-white-sugar subtype independently.
specific_prohibited_transfers: Do not use chromium 0.02 mg/kg for Misri (which can derive from any sugar or palmyrah juice).
Do not equate FSSR cube sugar total ash 0.03% with CTR lead sulphated ash 0.03%.
Do not automatically apply CTR lead refined white sugar <=0.5 mg/kg because the cube is white or contains >=99.7% sucrose.
Do not move stored sugar source-ingredient test results into a pressed finished cube test without verification.
Do not assume additives, coloured cubes, flavoured cubes or composite candies are the same named CTR refined sugar article.
Do not activate any future rule, claim full contaminant compliance or approve a production lot from this source mapping.
